a bare-stem lookup lists the catalogue (at most 4096 names); a relative name is resolved directly
pack storage budget: at most 256 records / 8 MiB per user, shared with the rest of LoRA Manager; one record at most 1 MiB

platform_observations: route request bodies near 1 MiB cannot reach the handler on a1: packroutes accepts up to 1 MiB (packroutes.py:142, 197-202), but the host-to-guest wire caps a frame at 1 MiB including its JSON envelope (wire.py:43). The host raises FrameTooLarge before sending (wire.py:450-454), which is a 500 'route handler failed' in production. The handler's own 413 record bound (notes record over 1 MiB) is therefore unreachable; Tier R r2 row S:record_value_bound expects FrameTooLarge (MERVYN m_6c597971dd).
